title: Staff Software Engineer - Full Stack
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Role

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.

In November 2023 we launched our non-food retail offering, Deliveroo 'Shopping', where we work with large and small merchants. We oversee all operations within the grocery and retail ecosystem, ensuring stores are equipped to receive and efficiently process orders. Our solutions empower stores to manage orders seamlessly through multiple channels, including our in-house app, API integration, and devices pre-installed with our software. Additionally, we provide tools to maintain and update product catalogs, ensuring accurate inventory for consumers. The technology we've developed enables our partners to pick the correct items swiftly while keeping inventory data current, optimizing both efficiency and accuracy.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our London, UK - Hybrid (3 days from the office) team. In this role, you'll help us define technical solutions for critical business problems and lead the technical direction for complex, high-scale systems.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a high-impact engineering group focused on solving unstructured and ambiguous challenges. You will act as a technical authority, aligning non-adjacent teams to deliver results that move the needle for the entire organisation.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Technical Excellence: Act as a subject matter expert, providing high-level reviews and technical advice across multiple teams.

  • Architect Scalable Solutions: Define and design technical solutions for complex business problems within a high-traffic environment (20krpm+).

  • Lead Strategic Direction: Influence the long-term technical roadmap and manage project timelines, risks, and sustainable delivery paces.

  • Mentor & Coach: Support the growth of engineers across all levels and partner with up-and-coming leaders to scale our engineering culture.

  • Shape the Team: Lead engineering interviews and contribute to recruiting strategy to ensure we maintain a high bar for talent.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Deep Technical Mastery: Significant experience building web-based applications at scale and a pride in writing readable, well-tested software.

  • Polyglot Mindset: Proficiency in (or a strong desire to learn) languages such as (Go, Ruby/Rails, Python, Scala, React or Rust)

  • Distributed Systems Expertise: Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL backends (Redis, DynamoDB, or Elasticsearch).

  • High-Scale Architecture: Proven ability to design and operate systems handling massive request volumes and complex logistical workflows.

  • Strategic Leadership: Strong understanding of how to align multiple disciplines and teams to resolve ambiguous technical challenges.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers, proud parents, and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
  • 🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.
  • 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
  • 🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.
  • ​​💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior Director, Commercial Sales
description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

Zip is looking for a Senior Director of EMEA Commercial Sales to lead and scale our Commercial business across Europe.

This is a second-line leadership role. You will initially lead two frontline Commercial Sales Managers and, through them, a growing team of Account Executives. As Zip expands across Europe, you will build the leadership structure, sales capacity, and go-to-market approach required to capture that opportunity.

Your leverage comes through your managers, but this is not a role for someone who operates from a distance. You will stay close to the business: understanding the pipeline, inspecting deals, helping your managers improve their teams, and personally getting involved in the opportunities where your experience can change the outcome.

You will own the performance of EMEA Commercial end to end: the number, pipeline, forecast, talent, geographic expansion, and operating rhythm of the segment.

Commercial is already an important part of Zip's EMEA business. The opportunity now is to turn it into a scaled, predictable growth engine across the region.

You Will

  • Own EMEA Commercial performance. Deliver quarterly and annual new-business revenue targets through the frontline managers and Account Executives who report into your organization.

  • Build and develop exceptional frontline managers. Coach your leaders on pipeline management, forecasting, deal inspection, rep development, and performance management. Hold them accountable for running their businesses with the same rigor you bring to yours.

  • Scale Commercial across Europe. Determine where and when to add coverage as Zip expands into new countries and markets, and build the teams and leadership required to win locally without creating unnecessary complexity.

  • Own pipeline well before the quarter begins. Establish coverage requirements, identify future gaps early, and work across Business Development, Marketing, Partnerships, and the AE organization to address them before they become revenue problems.

  • Drive rigorous forecasting. Build a business that is predictable. Know what is real, what is at risk, what has changed, and why, and ensure your managers operate with the same level of precision.

  • Stay close to the deals. Ensure your managers are inspecting opportunities rigorously, and personally engage in important customer conversations where executive involvement can improve discovery, create urgency, strengthen sponsorship, or move a deal forward.

  • Build a high-performance organization. Recruit outstanding managers and sellers, raise the talent bar as we grow, develop top performers, and address underperformance quickly and directly.

  • Improve the Commercial sales motion. Diagnose where performance is constrained by pipeline, execution, territory design, productivity, process, or capability and make the changes required to improve it.

  • Operate cross-functionally. Build strong partnerships with Business Development, Solution Consulting, Advisory, Marketing, Partnerships, GTM Operations, Customer, and Zip's Executive team.

  • Represent the Commercial business internally. Provide clear, credible reporting on performance, pipeline, forecast, market dynamics, competitive trends, and the investments required to continue scaling.

  • Build for where Zip is going, not where it is today. Create the leadership bench, operating model, and market coverage that will support a significantly larger EMEA Commercial organization over the next several years.

To Excel in This Role

  • You have successfully led frontline sales managers, not only individual sellers.

  • You know that your job as an L2 is not to run every deal yourself. You make your managers better at running their teams while knowing when your involvement can materially improve an outcome.

  • You are rigorous about pipeline creation and pipeline quality. You think several quarters ahead rather than discovering a pipeline problem once the quarter has begun.

  • You run a predictable business and have a strong track record of forecast accuracy and operational discipline.

  • You are comfortable getting into the details. You can move from a regional strategy discussion to inspecting a deal, a territory, a rep's pipeline, or a manager's operating cadence without losing altitude.

  • You have built or expanded sales teams across multiple European markets and understand that what works in the UK does not automatically translate into Germany, France, Benelux, Nordics, or Southern Europe.

  • You have a track record of hiring and developing strong sales leaders and creating a bench of future leadership talent.

  • You are equally comfortable with high expectations and hands-on coaching. You give clear, actionable feedback and address problems early.

  • You operate well in a fast-growth environment where the organization, product, market, and playbook are all evolving quickly.

  • You have a strong executive presence and can build credibility with senior customer stakeholders while keeping the Account Executive and frontline manager at the center of the relationship.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of B2B technology sales experience, including meaningful sales leadership experience.

  • 2+ years managing frontline sales managers or equivalent second-line leadership responsibility.

  • Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding revenue targets through teams.

  • Demonstrated experience scaling sales organizations across territories, countries, or customer segments.

  • Strong experience with pipeline management, forecasting, sales process, territory design, productivity metrics, and performance management.

  • Experience hiring and developing both sales managers and Account Executives.

  • Experience operating in a high-growth SaaS or enterprise technology company.

  • Experience selling through value-based, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Based in the UK and able to work from Zip's central London office three days per week.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience building sales teams outside the UK and entering new European markets.

  • Experience leading a high-velocity Commercial or mid-market SaaS organization.

  • Experience selling to Procurement, Finance, IT, Legal, or other cross-functional enterprise buyers.

title: Lead Java Developer/Solution Architect (6-month contract)
description:
gravity9 is recruiting Java engineers and architects for a portfolio of engagements across UK central government. These are large-scale, data-intensive modernisation programmes: replacing legacy systems that carry statutory weight, decomposing monoliths that serve millions of users, and building secure data platforms where access control and auditability are first-class architectural concerns rather than late additions.

We are hiring across two overlapping profiles — Senior Java Developer and Application / Migration Architect — and expect most people to move between programmes as engagements start and complete. Several of these are hands-on architect roles: you will own design decisions and also write production code

The kind of work

The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.

Secure data catalogue and access-control platform

A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.

Real-time decision-support data architecture

Replacing point-to-point integration across a multi-vendor estate with a microservices architecture and a common data layer, so that operational data flows in near real time instead of over days. The work includes target-state architecture and decision records, change-data-capture ingest pipelines from upstream data services, ontology and mapping-layer design across suppliers with competing data models, separation of system, reference and insight data classes including time-series, and deployment topologies spanning cloud-hosted services down to constrained edge hardware.

Legacy-to-document-model migration at national scale

Migrating hundreds of millions of records and tens of terabytes of XML out of a legacy relational platform into a sharded document store, in support of a COBOL-to-Java microservices rewrite. The work includes a configuration-driven XML-to-JSON transformation framework backed by a versioned schema registry — twenty years of history, multiple record types and continual schema and semantic drift; CDC and streaming pipelines, or a checkpointed parallel bulk-extract alternative; a field-level mapping validation and reconciliation framework robust enough to stand up to audit; a replay and failure-diagnostics harness with dead-letter routing and idempotent re-runs; and repeated dress rehearsals toward a single cutover window with no dual running.

Monolith decomposition and data-ownership migration

Breaking a distributed monolith of well over a hundred Java services sharing a handful of database clusters into domain-owned services — moving from borrowed data to owned data without reintroducing hidden coupling. The work includes bounded-context analysis to establish which domain genuinely owns which collections, in-place data remodelling ahead of any physical move, a data-access facade with feature-flagged per-request routing between old and new stores, dual-write / backfill / reconcile / read-switch cutover lifecycles with a defined rollback at every step, cluster-to-cluster streaming and live migration tooling, and automated parallel-run and diff-on-read testing.

What you will be doing

Emphasis varies by role and programme, but MongoDB is the common thread. Every one of these engagements involves modelling for it, migrating onto it, or building on top of it, and genuine depth here is what most differentiates candidates.

Architecture and design

•      Produce high- and low-level designs, security and data architectures, and architecture decision records — and take them through client design authorities and formal governance gates

•      Make and defend architectural trade-offs in front of both engineering and non-technical stakeholders, including client technical authorities and third-party suppliers

•      Analyse real access patterns and validate target MongoDB document models against genuine throughput, query and sharding requirements before they are baselined

•      Design integration boundaries in multi-vendor programmes where you own one component and must collaborate across the seams of others

Hands-on build

•      Build production Java services and RESTful APIs (Spring Boot or similar), designed for integration by multiple consuming systems and documented to OpenAPI

•      Design and implement MongoDB document models, aggregation pipelines, indexing and sharding strategies, and integrate them cleanly into Java service layers rather than through a leaky abstraction

•      Build data pipelines: CDC and streaming ingest, transformation frameworks, checkpointed batch extract workers, and MongoDB sink configuration and tuning at terabyte scale

•      Implement access control, encryption and audit within the application and data layer, including enforcement inside the MongoDB query path, rather than bolted on around it

•      Write the tests: unit, integration, golden-record fixtures, parallel-run reconciliation, and load and stress harnesses that prove performance under realistic volumes

•      Work across both MongoDB Atlas and Enterprise Advanced, including Kubernetes-hosted deployments, and with the migration and sync tooling around them

Data modernisation and migration

•      Model relational, XML or other legacy schemas onto MongoDB document models, handling schema and semantic drift through versioned, configuration-driven mappings rather than forked code

•      Design and prove cutover mechanisms — dual-write, backfill, reconcile, read-switch, rollback — for systems where a failed migration is not an acceptable outcome

•      Build validation and reconciliation tooling that satisfies audit: completeness, field-level fidelity, and query-level equivalence between old and new

Security, access control and assurance

•      Design and implement attribute- or role-based access control models, including enforcement at the data layer and policy administration

•      Work with application-layer and field-level encryption — MongoDB client-side field level and queryable encryption, and externally managed key material

•      Produce tamper-evident audit trails and observability that answer not just what happened but why

Client-facing delivery and enablement

•      Work as an embedded member of a small delivery team, frequently alongside client engineers and other suppliers

•      Run workshops, playbacks and sprint demonstrations; produce design documentation, integration guides and operational runbooks

•      Support knowledge transfer and upskilling of client teams — on these programmes enablement is a deliverable, not an afterthought

•      Use AI-assisted engineering tooling as part of normal delivery, within the constraints client security policy sets


Essential

•      Strong hands-on Java — building and running production services and RESTful APIs with Spring Boot or an equivalent framework

•      MongoDB — solid working experience covering document modelling, querying, aggregation pipelines and indexing, and integrating MongoDB into Java application layers. Atlas and/or Enterprise Advanced

•      Data-intensive systems — demonstrable experience of pipelines, migrations or integrations at meaningful scale, and sound reasoning about throughput, ordering, idempotency and failure recovery

•      API design — clean, well-documented REST interfaces suitable for integration by multiple consuming systems

•      Testing — genuine automated testing discipline, plus practical experience of load and stress testing against realistic volumes

•      Infrastructure and deployment — Terraform or equivalent infrastructure as code, containerised deployment on Kubernetes, and AWS or a comparable cloud

•      Communication — able to write clear design documentation and hold your own in a client design authority or architecture review

•      UK resident, and either holding current UK SC clearance or clearly eligible to obtain it

For architect-level roles we additionally expect:

•      Proven design authority on a delivery of comparable size and sensitivity, while remaining hands-on enough to prototype, pair and review code

•      Experience operating inside multi-vendor or multi-supplier programmes, including holding a technical position when other suppliers hold a different one

Desirable

•      UK public sector, or another regulated and security-conscious environment

•      Kafka and change-data-capture tooling such as Debezium; stream processing

•      Legacy modernisation patterns — strangler fig, operational data layers, dual running and phased cutover

•      Domain-driven design and bounded-context analysis; monolith decomposition

•      Attribute-based access control and policy-as-code frameworks (OPA, Casbin, XACML-based systems)

•      Field-level or client-side encryption, key management, HSM/KMS and KMIP integration

•      Search — Lucene-based or Atlas Search, vector search, hybrid retrieval and RAG patterns

•      Metadata standards such as DCAT or Dublin Core; data cataloguing, data mesh and federated data architecture concepts

•      Event-driven architecture and consistency patterns in distributed systems (saga, eventual consistency)

•      Oracle, COBOL or other mainframe and legacy platform familiarity

•      Time-series or geospatial data; deployment to constrained or edge hardware

•      AI-assisted development workflows and agentic coding tools

Working context

Engagement  Contract. Typically three to twelve months per programme, with a strong likelihood of rolling onto the next. Some roles begin part-time through a design phase before going full-time for build.

Clearance  SC clearance is the standard requirement for these roles, and current SC will always be the fastest route onto a programme. We will consider especially strong candidates who hold BPSS only and can sponsor SC in those cases, though clearance takes roughly three months and start dates will reflect that.

Residency  UK resident. All work on these programmes is delivered from the UK by UK-onshore staff.

Working model  Predominantly remote with periodic onsite attendance. Locations vary by programme — expect occasional travel to client sites including London, Manchester and Leeds.

Environment  Work is typically delivered through client-supplied devices or VDI, with VPN access to client environments. You should be comfortable operating within defined information-handling and access constraints, and with the pace that government security and onboarding processes set.

Team shape  Small, focused, multi-disciplinary teams. On several programmes gravity9 delivers alongside partner organisations and other suppliers, and you will need to work effectively across those boundaries.

Timing  These roles support a growing pipeline of central government work. Some engagements are contracted and mobilising; others are in contract negotiation with expected start dates in the coming months. We are building the bench now so that we can mobilise quickly, and clearance lead times mean early conversations are worthwhile even where a start date is not yet fixed.

• Manage pilots and implementation, and set the criteria for killing a pilot as clearly as the criteria for scaling it.

• Monitor performance, inference cost, latency and business impact.

• Collaborate with local teams, Group functions and technology partners.

.

title: Finance Manager, Financial Control & Accounting
description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

💰 Our Finance team

The Finance team ensures Joko's financial health and long-term success. We manage everything from financial planning and accounting to financing and cash management.

We make sure every euro is put to its best use, working closely with all teams, we provide the insights and structure needed to scale efficiently.

As we scale, we're splitting Finance into three specialized poles: FP&A, Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting), and Procurement. This role anchors Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) — the pole that keeps Joko's financial information accurate, timely, and audit-ready. You'll report directly to Quentin, our COO.

 

✨ Why this role is special

Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) is a brand-new specialized pole at Joko — previously bundled into a single generalist Finance Manager role. You'll be the first person to own this scope end to end, with direct visibility to the COO and VP Finance with real influence over how the function is built as the company scales past 200 people across multiple geographies.

  • You set the standards, not just follow them: as the pole's first hire, the processes, controls, and calendar you establish now become the backbone the rest of Finance builds on.

  • A true partner in automation: you'll work hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated — this isn't a role where you're expected to grind through manual work alone.

  • International scope from day one: France, the US, and future markets — you'll help build the multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as Joko expands.

 

🎯 What you will do

As Finance Manager, Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting), your main mission is to own the reliability, timeliness, and completeness of Joko's financial information. Rather than doing the bookkeeping — we have an external accounting partner for that — you set the standards, drive the calendar, and hold your internal and external stakeholders accountable.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Drive the closing calendar: own the monthly and annual closing calendar, holding our external accounting partner and auditors to a high standard;

  • Own our legal reporting package: make sure the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement are always accurate and delivered on time;

  • Oversee AP/AR end to end: keep invoicing, payment runs, and collections under control;

  • Lead our international accounting build-out: as we open new entities and markets, including our IFRS consolidation framework;

  • Own cash management: reconciliation, yield optimization, and day-to-day treasury;

  • Be the main point of contact for our banking and accounting partners, and a key interface for auditors as we scale toward IPO readiness;

  • Continuously strengthen and document our financial processes and controls, working hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated, making everything more robust and less error-prone as the company scales.

 

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: 4–8 years, with a strong foundation in accounting or audit (Big 4 or equivalent), ideally combined with in-house experience in a scale-up.

  • Education: A master's degree from a top business school. A double degree in accounting (DCG/DSCG) is a plus.

  • Financial rigor: Deep understanding of French GAAP and treasury fundamentals — you bring the same discipline to a closing cycle as you do to a cash position.

  • International mindset: Excited to build a multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as we expand; IFRS exposure is a plus.

  • Stakeholder management: You build trust with partners inside and outside Joko, and you're comfortable holding them accountable.

  • Problem solving: You dig into the root cause and fix things.

  • AI centricity: You use AI in your daily work today, and you're excited to help automate reporting and reconciliation as part of Joko's AI-first finance ambition.

  • Languages: Fluent French and English.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform
description:
The Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform is responsible for building, running, and evolving the ML monorepo used by the X-ray, CT, and MRI machine learning group at DeepHealth. The monorepo covers the full path from experimentation to product: dataset and sample definitions, training and evaluation code, experiment tracking, model export, and the inference servers that run in production. Everyone on the team contributes to the monorepo; this role is the single point of accountability for it. This hands-on role owns the architecture, tooling, and engineering standards of that codebase for a distributed team of about twenty machine learning engineers and scientists, working with model developers and software engineers to make the team’s work fast, better, and easier to audit. It also leads the team's agentic coding strategy, shaping how AI coding agents are used across the codebase. The role reports to the Leader of the ML for X-ray/CT/MRI group.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities  

  • Own the architecture and roadmap of the ML Monorepo:

    • Module boundaries, shared abstractions for datasets and samples, training and evaluation loops, configuration, and experiment tracking.

  • Build and run the engineering tooling around the codebase:

    • Continuous integration, testing, dependency management, containers, artifact and model registries, and GPU job scheduling on cloud (GCP) and HPC infrastructure.

  • Own the path from trained checkpoint to deployable model:

    • Model packaging, inference servers with enforced API contracts, reproducibility, and performance and memory budgets on target hardware.

  • Define and enforce engineering standards (code review, testing, documentation) in a way that accelerates research rather than slowing it down.

  • Ensure traceability of data, code, and model versions across experiments and releases.

  • Investigate and resolve performance, reliability, and usability issues in the stack raised by the team and reduce their recurrence through shared tooling.

  • Drive the team's agentic coding strategy: define how AI coding agents are used in the monorepo, set up the tooling, guardrails, and conventions that make them effective, and help colleagues adopt them.

  • Review code, mentor colleagues on engineering practices, and communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above.  Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.


Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience 

  • Master's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (required).

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including a significant portion building infrastructure or tooling used by machine learning teams, such as an ML platform or a training framework (required).

  • Strong Python skills and software engineering fundamentals: API design, testing, refactoring, and attention to developer experience (required).

  • Solid PyTorch knowledge and practical experience with model training and profiling (required).

  • Experience running ML workloads on a cloud platform, ideally GCP (Vertex AI, Artifact Registry, IAM, storage), and with containerization (required).

  • Experience taking models to production: model packaging, inference serving, and performance and reliability constraints (required).

  • Ability to work closely with researchers, translate recurring pain points into shared tooling, and push back constructively when needed (required).

  • Ability to work autonomously in a distributed, multi-site team, with clear verbal and written communication in English (required).

  • Medical imaging experience (DICOM, 3D volumes, large images) (preferred).

  • HPC and Slurm experience (preferred).

  • Contributions to open-source ML tooling (preferred).

Quality Standards 

  • Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors. 

  • Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.  

  • Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

  • Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

  • Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times. 

  • Practices universal safety precautions.

  • Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person. 

  • Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems. 

  • Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

  • Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Travel

This position may require occasional travel between team sites (Paris, the Netherlands, Grenoble/Rennes).

Working Environment 

Office / Hybrid. Paris, Île-de-France, France.

Physical Demands 

The employee must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Salary:

Dependent upon experience

50,000-80,000 EURO

  • Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.
  • Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.

  • La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

  • Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.
  • Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.

Rémunération

Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.

Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

  • Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.
  • Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.
  • Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.
  • Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.
  • Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.
  • Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer.

Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.

Formation et accompagnement

Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients.

Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.

Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation.

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ Why we are hiring ⭐️

We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end: you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition: We have just passed the one million member milestone – and this is only the beginning! We’re accelerating acquisition in France and doubling down on our portfolio — and the Enterprise segment is one of the core pillars of that plan.

About the Enterprise segment

  • Perimeter: companies of 3000+ employees

  • Verticals: all Verticals (Tech, Retail, Industrial Companies etc)

  • Total Addressable Market: ~7M members in France

Why Enterprise Sales is exciting at Alan

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers, Unions, long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise Account Executives.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of the Enterprise Sales team in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and scaling the machine.

More precisely, you will:

  • Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment.

  • Lead & coach a team of 4 Account Executives (and likely more to come)

    • Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment.

    • Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow‑up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution, and pipeline management.

    • Be on the field with the team: prospecting, joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the team: Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: strong feedback culture, coaching, clear ownership, and autonomy.

  • Ensure market fit and remove blockers: Surface customer expectations, patterns, and blockers, and ensure they’re addressed through the right strategic and execution plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-G level range.

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? ⭐

You may be a great fit at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 10 years experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

  • Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction, and help people grow

  • Have full working proficiency in French, and advanced level in English for internal communication

  • Have a very hands‑on mentality: you love being on the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations, and sharing what works

  • Have experience selling to Enterprise level companies (3000+ employees and above) in multi‑stakeholder deals

  • Are comfortable operating in fast‑paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

  • Are data‑driven and analytical: you know how to leverage KPIs to drive performance, run analyses, and make decisions

  • Have strong cross‑functional collaboration skills and appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

  • Are based (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area

Nice-to-have:

.

title: Product Manager
description:
Role summary

Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day.

We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted.

Responsibilities

  • Product vision, grounded in real user needs

You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind.

  • Market scoping and opportunity-spotting

Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog.

  • Logistics know-how turned into product decisions 

Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you.

  • The full lifecycle

From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear.

  • The connective tissue across the company 

When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together.

The team you’ll join

You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today.

Life at Bluerock

We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock.


  • 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required.

  • An appetite for ambiguity and change: a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem.

  • Nice to have: API integration experience (WMS, ERP, visibility providers, customs), fluency with Agile tooling (Jira, Asana, Rocketlane), and PMP/PRINCE2 certification.

  • Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively.

  • Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment

In this role, you will design ruggedized chassis, enclosures, and mechanical assemblies that protect and integrate electronic, photonic, fiber-optic, and electromechanical subsystems. You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams and external partners to develop robust, manufacturable, and serviceable hardware solutions that support integration, qualification, manufacturing, and long-term operation.

  • Design robust hardware solutions that meet vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, environmental, serviceability, and lifecycle requirements for energy and marine applications.

  • Develop modular, maintainable, and upgradeable hardware architectures that support manufacturability, serviceability, and long-term product support.

title: Senior Embedded Software Test Engineer

As a Senior Embedded Software Test Engineer at Optics11, you own the embedded software system-test capability for our sensing interrogator platforms. Your scope covers the integrated behavior of embedded Linux applications and services, internal and external APIs, hardware interfaces, firmware and FPGA interactions, system control, calibration and configuration, diagnostics, data acquisition, boot and update behavior, recovery mechanisms, and sensor interfaces. You build and maintain automated test frameworks, HIL benches, test harnesses, CI/CD integration, and objective release evidence that make product behavior repeatable, observable, and measurable.

You are part of the Sensing Platform Team and work closely with Embedded Software, FPGA/Firmware, Electronics, Photonics, Architects, Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, application/software teams, and external development partners.   • Je hebt basiskennis van programmeren en vindt het leuk om hierin verder te leren;

  • Zelfstandig werken gaat je goed af en je neemt graag zelf initiatief;

  • Je kunt goed communiceren in het Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.


Over Flagship

Flagship Amsterdam is een jonge en snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers.

Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan unieke events en creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren.

title: Teamleider ICT & Security (m/v/x)
description:
DNW zoekt een teamleider die ICT en security samenbrengt: iemand die zorgt dat onze medewerkers goed kunnen werken, onze systemen betrouwbaar beschikbaar zijn en onze informatie veilig blijft.

Wat ga je doen?

Je geeft leiding aan het team ICT & Security en bent verantwoordelijk voor de integrale aansturing van ICT en het organisatie brede security domein (Duitsland en Nederland). Je zorgt voor een samenhangende aanpak van fysieke beveiliging, informatiebeveiliging en IT-/cybersecurity in lijn met ISO 27001, wet- en regelgeving en de organisatiedoelstellingen.

·        Beheer, licenties en onderhoud van computers, software en mobiele apparatuur;

Je bent een verbindende en resultaatgerichte teamleider die begrijpt dat ICT en security geen doel op zich zijn, maar randvoorwaarden voor een goed functionerende organisatie.

Je combineert een mensgerichte leiderschapsstijl met voldoende inhoudelijke kennis en organisatiesensitiviteit. Je kunt gemakkelijk schakelen tussen strategische vraagstukken en de dagelijkse praktijk. Je weet complexe ICT- en securityvraagstukken terug te brengen tot heldere keuzes en concrete acties.

Je hebt bovendien oog voor het bredere belang van de organisatie. Je begrijpt dat goede ICT-dienstverlening draait om continuïteit en gebruiksgemak, maar dat dit altijd in balans moet zijn met veiligheid, privacy, compliance en kosten.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Als Senior Machine Learning Engineer bij BigData Republic combineer je diepgaande technische expertise met consultancy. Je ontwikkelt niet alleen machine-learningoplossingen, maar brengt ze daadwerkelijk naar productie en adviseert klanten over architectuur, technologie en de beste aanpak om duurzame businesswaarde te realiseren.

Voor deze senior positie zoeken we een ervaren professional met minimaal 6 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met machine learning in professionele productieomgevingen.

Wat ga je doen?

Machine Learning Engineering bevindt zich bij BigData Republic op het snijvlak van Machine Learning, MLOps, Software Engineering, Data Engineering en Cloud Engineering.

Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams bij klanten aan end-to-end machine-learningoplossingen: van probleemdefinitie en architectuur tot ontwikkeling, deployment, monitoring en optimalisatie.

Je;

  • analyseert complexe business- en technische vraagstukken en vertaalt deze naar robuuste ML-oplossingen;

  • adviseert klanten en stakeholders over machine learning, MLOps, architectuur en technische keuzes;

  • ontwikkelt en productionaliseert machine-learningmodellen;

  • ontwerpt schaalbare ML- en MLOps-architecturen;

  • bouwt production-grade software rondom machine-learningoplossingen;

  • werkt aan deployment, CI/CD, model serving, monitoring en observability;

  • werkt samen met Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Software Engineers en Cloud Engineers;

  • helpt klanten en collega's inhoudelijk naar een hoger niveau;

  • draagt actief bij aan kennisdeling en thought leadership binnen BigData Republic.

De technische uitdagingen variëren van machine-learningmodellen met directe businessimpact tot toepassingen rond deep learning, generative AI, Large Language Models (LLM's), predictive modelling, causal inference en reinforcement learning.

Bij BigData Republic zien we een machine-learningmodel niet als het eindproduct. Een model levert pas waarde wanneer het betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en beheersbaar in productie draait. Daarom benaderen we ML-oplossingen als volwaardige softwareproducten.

Technologieën waarmee we veel werken zijn onder andere;

  • Python

  • Airflow

  • Apache Spark

  • Kafka

  • Docker

  • Tensorflow

  • Pytorch

  • Kubernetes

  • Terraform

  • AWS/ Azur/ GCP en private-cloud omgevingen


Welke technologie je inzet, hangt af van het vraagstuk. We zoeken daarom geen engineer die simpelweg zoveel mogelijk tools kent, maar een ervaren professional die begrijpt welke technische oplossing in welke situatie passend is en waarom.

Je werkt aan complexe data-, AI- en machine-learningvraagstukken voor grote organisaties in verschillende sectoren. Tegelijkertijd ben je onderdeel van een klein, informeel en inhoudelijk gedreven team van ervaren Machine Learning Engineers, MLOps Engineers, Data Engineers en Data Scientists.

Kennisdeling en thought leadership zijn fundamentele onderdelen van BigData Republic. We organiseren iedere vrijdag kennissessies op kantoor, schrijven inhoudelijke artikelen, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om je eigen expertise verder te ontwikkelen en tegelijkertijd collega's en klanten verder te helpen.


Dit is nadrukkelijk een senior consultancyrol. Om succesvol te kunnen zijn in deze functie zoeken we iemand die beschikt over:

  • minimaal 6 jaar relevante professionele werkervaring binnen software engineering, data engineering, data science en/of machine learning;

  • minimaal 3 jaar hands-on professionele ervaring met machine learning, waarbij je aantoonbaar ML-oplossingen naar productie hebt gebracht en beheerd, verbeterd of opgeschaald;

  • ervaring met het zelfstandig analyseren van complexe technische vraagstukken en het adviseren van klanten en stakeholders over oplossingen, architectuur en technische keuzes;

  • ruime professionele programmeerervaring met Python;

  • gedegen kennis van software-engineeringprincipes en ervaring met het bouwen van production-grade oplossingen;

  • ervaring met minimaal één grote cloudomgeving: AWS, Azure en/of GCP;

  • ervaring met MLOps, waaronder deployment, CI/CD, monitoring, observability en schaalbaarheid;

  • academisch werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een achtergrond in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied;

  • uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands (minimaal C1) en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Daarnaast is het van toegevoegde waarde als je ervaring hebt met:

  • consultancy binnen complexe enterprise-omgevingen;

  • solution architecture of technical leadership;

  • Kubernetes en Terraform;

  • Spark, Kafka en/of Airflow;

  • TensorFlow en/of PyTorch;

  • generative AI en Large Language Models (LLM's);

  • deep learning, causal inference of reinforcement learning;

  • Scala, Kotlin en/of SQL;

  • open-sourceprojecten, meetups, conferenties of andere vormen van kennisdeling.

We verwachten niet dat je met iedere technologie uit onze stack hebt gewerkt. De senioriteit van je ervaring, het daadwerkelijk in productie brengen van machine-learningoplossingen, je vermogen om klanten inhoudelijk te adviseren en je beheersing van het Nederlands zijn voor deze rol wel essentieel.

Je bent technisch sterk, maar kijkt verder dan alleen de technologie. Je kunt complexe situaties doorgronden, alternatieven afwegen en uitleggen waarom een bepaalde oplossing wel of niet verstandig is. Je voelt je comfortabel in gesprekken met engineers, architecten en business stakeholders.

Tegelijkertijd blijf je graag zelf bouwen. BigData Republic zoekt geen consultant die alleen vanaf de zijlijn adviseert: je combineert senior technisch advies met hands-on Machine Learning Engineering.

title: Senior Corporate Tech Recruiter
description:
Bouw mee aan recruitment voor een hoogwaardige tech consultancy

Senior tech professionals vinden vraagt meer dan vacatures publiceren en sollicitaties beoordelen. De beste kandidaten zijn vaak niet actief op zoek. Je moet weten waar je ze vindt, hoe je ze benadert en hoe je ze enthousiast maakt voor een inhoudelijk gesprek.

Bij Conflux zoeken we daarom een Senior Corporate Tech Recruiter die recruitment en sourcing beheerst. Iemand die zelfstandig de arbeidsmarkt benadert, hiring managers adviseert en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor het volledige recruitmentproces.

Conflux is een Nederlandse tech consultancy met gespecialiseerde expertise binnen onder andere Data & AI, Software Development, Cloud en Platform Engineering. Onze consultants werken aan complexe technische vraagstukken en behoren inhoudelijk tot de ervaren professionals binnen hun vakgebied.

Dat betekent dat onze recruitment vraagstukken niet eenvoudig zijn. We zoeken onder andere Senior Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Java Developers, Kubernetes Engineers, Platform Engineers en Front-end Developers.

Daarvoor zoeken we een recruiter die zijn of haar vak verstaat.

Wat je gaat doen

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de werving van ervaren technische consultants binnen onder andere:

  • Data Engineering & AI

  • Machine Learning

  • Java Development

  • Kubernetes & Cloud Native

  • Cloud & Platform Engineering

  • Front-end Development

Je beheert het recruitmentproces van arbeidsmarktanalyse en sourcing tot selectie en aanbieding.

Concreet betekent dit dat je:

  • actief technische professionals sourcet en benadert, onder andere via LinkedIn Recruiter en andere sourcingkanalen;

  • zelfstandig searches en sourcingstrategieën ontwikkelt voor moeilijk vindbare doelgroepen;

  • kandidaten screent op ervaring, technische context, motivatie en consultancy-fit;

  • hiring managers adviseert over doelgroep, haalbaarheid, arbeidsmarkt, selectiecriteria en recruitmentaanpak;

  • kandidaten gedurende het volledige proces begeleidt en zorgt voor een professionele en persoonlijke candidate experience;

  • interview- en selectieprocessen bewaakt en waar nodig bijstuurt;

  • talentpools opbouwt en relaties onderhoudt met relevante professionals;

  • data en recruitmentinzichten gebruikt om keuzes en prioriteiten te onderbouwen;

  • externe recruitmentpartners inzet wanneer dit aantoonbaar waarde toevoegt;

  • kansen signaleert om recruitment slimmer, sneller en effectiever te organiseren.

Ongeveer 85% van je tijd ben je bezig met recruitment en sourcing. De overige tijd gebruik je om recruitment verder te professionaliseren, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van tooling, data, processen, arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, AI of nieuwe sourcingmethoden.

Je bent daarmee niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor vacatures, maar mede-eigenaar van hoe recruitment binnen Conflux wordt uitgevoerd en ontwikkeld.


We zoeken nadrukkelijk een ervaren tech recruiter die zelfstandig kan opereren in een markt waarin kandidaten schaars zijn en actief gevonden en overtuigd moeten worden.

Dit breng je mee

  • Minimaal 6 jaar professionele recruitmentervaring.

  • Minimaal 4 jaar aantoonbare ervaring met IT- of tech recruitment.

  • Ervaring met het zelfstandig werven van ervaren of senior technische professionals.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met active sourcing en direct search.

  • Je weet hoe je een technische doelgroep analyseert en vertaalt naar een effectieve search- en benaderingsstrategie.

  • Je kunt inhoudelijk voldoende meepraten over technische rollen en begrijpt het verschil tussen bijvoorbeeld software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, cloud en platform engineering.

  • Je bent ervaren met LinkedIn Recruiter en weet dat goede sourcing verder gaat dan alleen LinkedIn.

  • Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor hiring managers en durft recruitmentvraagstukken kritisch te benaderen.

  • Je kunt zelfstandig prioriteiten bepalen en meerdere complexe vacatures tegelijkertijd managen.

  • Je combineert snelheid met kwaliteit en houdt grip op voortgang en candidate experience.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft professioneel Nederlands en Engels.

Ervaring met recruitment binnen tech consultancy, IT-dienstverlening, detachering of een vergelijkbare kennisintensieve omgeving is van toegevoegde waarde.

Wie jij bent

Je hebt weinig dagelijkse aansturing nodig. Je ziet waar recruitment stagneert, onderzoekt waarom en komt met oplossingen.

Je wacht niet alleen op sollicitanten, maar gaat zelf de markt in.

Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe sourcingmethoden, tooling en technologie en experimenteert graag met manieren om moeilijk bereikbare kandidaten toch te vinden.

Tegelijkertijd begrijp je dat recruitment uiteindelijk draait om mensen. Je bouwt relaties op, communiceert duidelijk en zorgt ervoor dat kandidaten ook bij een afwijzing een professionele ervaring hebben.



Waarom Conflux?

Je komt terecht in een organisatie waarin recruitment dicht op de business zit. De lijnen met hiring managers en directie zijn kort en er is ruimte om vanuit jouw expertise invloed uit te oefenen op hoe we recruitment organiseren.

Je krijgt:

  • veel zelfstandigheid en vertrouwen;

  • directe invloed op recruitmentstrategie en sourcing;

  • ruimte om nieuwe sourcingmethoden en tooling te introduceren;

  • inhoudelijk sterke collega's binnen verschillende technische disciplines;

  • korte lijnen met hiring managers en directie;

  • ruimte om recruitmentprocessen daadwerkelijk te verbeteren.

Wat we bieden

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
Wij zoeken geen recruiter die wacht op sollicitaties.

adesso Nederland groeit. En de mensen die wij zoeken, zijn meestal niet actief op zoek naar een nieuwe baan.

Daarom zoeken we een Senior Recruiter die recruitment écht beheerst.

Iemand die begrijpt dat een vacature online zetten het begin is en niet de strategie.

Je weet hoe je zelf de markt in gaat. Je searcht, sourcet, benadert en bouwt relaties op. Je probeert verschillende invalshoeken als een search niet werkt. Je kent LinkedIn Recruiter, maar weet ook dat sourcing meer is dan een paar zoektermen invoeren en InMails versturen.

En misschien nog belangrijker: je hebt ideeën.

Over waar we talent kunnen vinden. Over hoe we mensen kunnen benaderen. Over employer branding. Over onze propositie als werkgever. Over tooling, data, events, referrals, communities en alles wat ons kan helpen om betere mensen aan adesso te verbinden.

Zie je een kans? Dan verwachten we niet dat je wacht tot iemand je vertelt wat je moet doen.

Je pakt hem.

Wat ga je doen?

Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheid voor recruitment binnen adesso Nederland en werkt nauw samen met hiring managers en management.

Daarbij ben je zowel strategisch als operationeel.

Want senior zijn betekent bij ons niet dat je alleen adviseert.

Je doet het ook zelf.

Je:

  • voert zelfstandig searches uit naar schaarse IT-professionals;

  • bouwt talentpools op in plaats van pas te zoeken zodra er een vacature ontstaat;

  • benadert kandidaten persoonlijk en weet hun interesse te wekken;

  • experimenteert met nieuwe sourcingkanalen en manieren van benaderen;

  • voert intakes met hiring managers en durft kritisch te zijn op het profiel dat zij zoeken;

  • adviseert over haalbaarheid, arbeidsmarkt, salaris en recruitmentstrategie;

  • voert gesprekken met kandidaten en begeleidt het proces van eerste contact tot hire;

  • houdt overzicht over je vacatures en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat;

  • gebruikt data om te begrijpen wat wel en niet werkt;

  • komt zelf met voorstellen om recruitment slimmer en effectiever te maken;

  • denkt mee over employer branding, referral recruitment, events en communities;

  • bouwt mee aan hoe recruitment binnen adesso Nederland zich verder ontwikkelt.

Je krijgt daarbij geen dichtgetimmerd recruitmenthandboek.

We verwachten juist dat jij vanuit je ervaring kunt zeggen:

“Dit werkt niet. Ik denk dat we het zo moeten aanpakken.”

En vervolgens help je om het te realiseren.

Wanneer ben je voor ons senior?

Niet omdat er ‘Senior Recruiter’ op je LinkedIn-profiel staat.

Voor ons zit senioriteit in hoe je werkt.

Je hoeft niet gevraagd te worden om te sourcen je weet dat het onderdeel van je vak is.

Als een search niets oplevert, concludeer je niet dat “de markt lastig is”. Je verandert je aanpak.

Als een hiring manager een onrealistisch profiel zoekt, durf je dat gesprek te voeren.

Als je ziet dat ons recruitmentproces beter kan, kom je niet alleen met het probleem maar ook met een voorstel.

En als je een goed idee hebt, krijg je energie van het daadwerkelijk uitvoeren ervan.



We zoeken iemand met stevige recruitmentervaring, bij voorkeur binnen IT, tech of consultancy.

Maar het aantal jaren ervaring vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je daadwerkelijk kunt.

We willen vooral zien dat je:

  • aantoonbaar sterk bent in search, sourcing en direct benaderen;

  • weet hoe je schaarse senior professionals vindt en interesseert;

  • verschillende sourcingstrategieën kunt bedenken én uitvoeren;

  • creatief bent in het vinden van nieuwe kandidaten en doelgroepen;

  • verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor je vacatures en resultaten;

  • zelfstandig prioriteiten stelt;

  • hiring managers als volwaardig gesprekspartner adviseert;

  • kritisch durft te zijn wanneer dat nodig is;

  • nieuwsgierig bent naar nieuwe recruitmenttechnieken, tooling en AI;

  • met data naar je eigen recruitmentfunnel kijkt;

  • ideeën niet alleen bedenkt, maar ook uitvoert;

  • Nederlands en Engels professioneel beheerst.

Wat je bij ons niet hoeft te doen

Wachten tot iemand je vertelt welke Boolean search je moet gebruiken.

Wachten tot marketing met een employer-brandingidee komt.

Wachten tot een hiring manager vraagt waarom een vacature al zes weken openstaat.

Of iedere week uitleggen dat de markt nu eenmaal moeilijk is.

Natuurlijk is de IT-arbeidsmarkt moeilijk.

Dat is precies waarom we een goede Senior Recruiter zoeken.

Wat krijg je daarvoor terug?

Veel vrijheid.

Maar vrijheid betekent bij ons ook verantwoordelijkheid.

Je krijgt de ruimte om recruitment mede vorm te geven en nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. adesso werkt met korte lijnen, veel autonomie en ruimte voor initiatief. Onze Culture Code draait onder andere om hands-on, straightforward en open-minded werken.

Dat betekent: aanpakken, zeggen wat je denkt en openstaan voor betere ideeën.

Verder kun je rekenen op:

  • een vast dienstverband voor 32–40 uur per week;

  • 27 vakantiedagen;

  • een goede pensioenregeling en aanvullende verzekeringen;

  • internationale ontwikkelmogelijkheden binnen adesso;

  • en vooral: ruimte om recruitment beter neer te zetten.

Klinkt dit bekend?

Misschien zie je tijdens het lezen van deze vacature al drie dingen die je anders zou doen.

Mooi.

Dan zijn we waarschijnlijk naar jou op zoek.

We zoeken geen recruiter die onze huidige manier van werken netjes in stand houdt.

We zoeken iemand die helpt om hem beter te maken.
